_comment: Committed baseline for the search-relevance golden set. Regenerate deliberately and review the diff — never re-baseline to make a red build green. Metrics are measured over the frozen fixtures in ./fixtures, so they only move when the ranker moves.
_metricsComment: precisionAt5/mrr measure RANKING over queries that returned something. coverage is the answer rate and is gated separately: a query-understanding change that stops matching a hard class of queries would otherwise raise the ranking metrics by removing those queries from the average.
_knownGateViolationsComment: Empty on purpose. Both defects this corpus was built around — Milchdrink UHT returning Milchschokolade, and Protein Milch returning bread — do NOT reproduce against the 2026-08-01 capture. The gate queries therefore act as regression guards rather than documented breakage; if either reappears in the top 5, the build fails.
